meta.source: Energy Institute, Statistical Review of World Energy 2026 (formerly BP Statistical Review)
meta.note: Annual panel for the EMMI country/region dropdown. Oil and gas production & consumption, and total energy supply (TES, EI's primary energy consumption), are unmodified EI 2026 figures. Population is EI's own series (stored in the meadow file as millions; converted to people here). Oil and gas per capita are computed from those two EI series (barrels/person/year = kbd × 365.25 / population; m³/person/year = bcm × 1e9 / population). TES per capita is EI's own tes_gj_pc. There is no official EI 'total energy production' total — production is shown for oil and for gas; total energy is TES (consumption/supply), not an invented production sum. GDP is World Bank WDI constant 2015 USD, country-level only; regional GDP is null (region membership must not be mixed with Bank aggregates). Null means unavailable. No interpolation, no paid sources.
meta.gdp_source: World Bank World Development Indicators, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD and NY.GDP.PCAP.KD (constant 2015 US$)
